data.title: Air Canada Named Best Airline in North America at the 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards
data.description: Air Canada has been awarded the title of Best Airline in North America for the second consecutive year at the prestigious 2026 Skytrax World Airline Awards, marking their tenth win since 2010. The awards, based on feedback from millions of travelers worldwide, were held in London, UK. Furthermore, the Toronto Air Canada Signature Suite secured the top spot as the World’s Best Business Class Lounge Dining for the third year running. Air Canada also received accolades for Best Cabin Crew in Canada, Best Economy On Board Catering in North America, and Best Business Class Lounge in North America.

data.title: Avangrid Foundation Supports Future Energy Workforce Through Scholarships at Kennebec Valley Community College
data.description: The Avangrid Foundation, linked to energy giant Avangrid Inc., part of the Iberdrola Group, has granted $10,000 to Kennebec Valley Community College (KVCC) for the Avangrid Foundation/Central Maine Power Scholarship Fund. This funding aims to offer five scholarships worth $2,000 each to students in KVCC's Electrical Lineworker Technology and Electrical Technology programs for the academic year 2026-2027. This initiative seeks to support students pursuing careers in the energy sector.

data.title: First Washington Realty Invests $65M+ to Expand Grocery-Anchored Shopping Center Portfolio in Midwest
data.description: First Washington Realty ("FWR"), a real estate investment firm, has purchased two grocery-anchored shopping centers in Minnesota and Missouri for over $65 million. This acquisition increases FWR's portfolio to 21.9 million square feet in 21 states. One of the centers, The Village of Blaine, spans 220,685 square feet and is located in Minnesota.

data.description: According to recent data, the unemployment rate in the United States has dropped to a record low of 3.7%. This marks the lowest rate in nearly 50 years, with 134,000 jobs added in September alone. The strong job growth has been observed across various sectors, including healthcare, manufacturing, and transportation. Economists attribute this positive trend to an increase in consumer spending and business investments. Additionally, the average hourly earnings have increased by 2.8% over the past year, indicating a steady rise in wages for American workers. Overall, the labor market appears to be thriving, reflecting a robust and healthy economy.

data.title: COSRX Brings Its 5 Peptide Lip Collection to Ulta Beauty Stores Offline
data.description: After a successful launch online, COSRX is now introducing its inaugural color-infused skincare hybrid lip collection to physical retail locations, offering Peptide-powered lip treatments. The expansion comes after the product's positive reception. The brand, recognized for its expertise in derma beauty, is bringing this new line to stores. The development was announced in New York on Sept. 18, 2026.
